body:
Its a monday, a snow day.  I sleep in until 11, when I wake up I realize today is a great opportunity to do some drugs.  My parents will be out for at least a few hours and its beautiful outside, everything's covered in snow.  I peruse through my drug collection of LSD, MDMA, DMT, Psilocybin, Vicodin, Klonopin, Adderall, Ambien, weed, and alcohol,  I decide on combining 10mg hydrocodone and 1 mg klonopin.  The only other time I had combined opiates and benzos was 8 months prior and it didnt go so weIl (I took 35mg oxycodone and 2mg valium on zero tolerance, I almost overdosed and was very sick for the next couple days) so this time I decided to dose a lot lighter.  I usually take 20-25mg of hydro by itself or 2-3mg klonopin by itself, so I decided on 10hydro/1klono.
Ingest these at 11:17 am with a glass of mango juice on an empty stomach.  I then decide to take a shower.  Throughout the hot shower I felt the effects begin to come on.  By the time I got out of the shower I could really started to feel the lightheaded, relaxing, daze of opiates and benzos (+30min)
At 12pm I decide to takes a couple hits of weed out of my MFLB to enhance the effects.  (+45) Now I feel the full effects, my coordination is shit and my body is very sedated.
I then decided to listen to the album JuJu by Wayne Shorter.  The whole time I felt this euphoric warm blanket that was flowing throughout my body.  I was just laying on my couch in a bathrobe fully indulging in jazzs mystical powers.  The music had more of a message behind it and all the solos made complete sense and told a story.  I had no desire to move and was overall very happy in all ways.  I would occasionally nod off into a dream like state where the music was going directly along with these half dreams, manipulating what was happening depending on the mood of the music.
(+1:18) At 12:35 pm I take another 5mg of hydrocodone and type this.  After that I ended up practicing jazz drum set from 12:40 until now (1:25).  All my ideas flowed freely on to the drumset and my solos were very complex with much development, Im very happy with that practice session .  As soon as I finished practicing I took 1 more hit off my MFLB and typed this.  Now Im in the mood for a walk, I get back to you when I come back! GREAT walk, I listened to tibetan singing bowls while I strolled through a snowy wonderland.  There were enormous snow mountains on every corner from the snow plows, it was incredible mixed with what I was listening to.  I was stumbling a lot from the sedation but I enjoyed the walk none the less.  It is now 2:41 and the effects are still strong.  I just made some pasta, AMAZING.  I take another hit from the MFLB and enjoy my first meal of the day.  Now I will take a nap.  Overall today was a great experience, perfect way to spend a snow day :)
